title: Dar Dar Phirai Gayi Baba
body:
Dar Dar Phirayi Gayi Baba
Balwe me laayi gayi Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
1)
Haye kaha'n jaun is kamsini me
Kab tak mai gham khau'n is kamsini me
Itna satayi gayi baba
<<DIVIDER>>
2)
Jabse gaye ho ye dil hai paresha'n
Har shaam meri hai shame Ghareeba'n
Bus Mai rulayi gayi baba
<<DIVIDER>>
3)
Zindaan ka hai ajab khooni manzar
Dekho zara aake kaato'n ka bistar
Uspar Sulayi gayi baba
<<DIVIDER>>
4)
Dekhi nahi jaati thi unki haalat
Bikhri hui ran me pamaal mayyat
Humko dikhayi gayi baba
<<DIVIDER>>
5)
Khaati thi rone pe baba tamache
Raaho me phir meri takleef aise
Aakar badhayi gayi baba
<<DIVIDER>>
6)
Is haal me kaun mujhko sambhale
Raaho me kaate'n hain pairo me chaale
Uspar chalayi gayi baba
<<DIVIDER>>
7)
Is kamsini me wo dekha hai manzar
Beemar bhai ko maqtal me laakar
Bedi pihnayi gayi baba
<<DIVIDER>>
8)
Rote hain dekho shabab aur Haider
Kehti rahi ek beti tadapkar
Qaidi banayi gayi baba
<<DIVIDER>>
